newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says underestimated Boeing, McDonnell problems.
newsitem.headline: EU says underestimated Boeing, McDonnell problems.

text.p: European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said Monday he might have underestimated the problems with the planned merger between Boeing and McDonnell Douglas.
The European Commission plans to open a full probe later this week, he said.
"There is going to be a fully-fledged investigation," Van Miert said as he arrived at the European Parliament to speak to a committee on an unrelated subject.
He added: "I have the impression that I had under-rated the problems."
The official announcement of the probe is expected on Wednesday. It could take up to four months.

The merger between the two U.S. aircraft makers was submitted to the EU for clearance last month under EU rules that ban creation or strengthening of dominant positions in the 15-nation bloc. It is also being investigated by the U.S. authorities.
Boeing has said that it hopes to have cleared all regulatory hurdles by July.
Van Miert declined to detail his competition concerns but vowed to do whatever was needed to ensure fair competition in the aviation market.
